v1.text: Are you tired of the yes men surrounding you?

v2.text: Do you need to be yelled at to get motivated?

v3.text: If yes... have you met Sergeant Pace?

v4.text: Can't run? Good. Nobody can on day one. We start with thirty seconds.

v5.text: Run! Walk! Run! Slow is the whole point, recruit.

v6.text: Effort nine? Are you trying to retire early?! I just rewrote your whole plan.

v8.text: Then see a doctor. Then get back here.

v9.text: Five K. Ten K. Half. Full marathon. No excuses.
